patch_description: Replace the degenerate all-zero construction with a deterministic maximin search in barycentric coordinates. The three triangle vertices are retained as extremal hull points, while the remaining eight points are optimized inside the equilateral triangle. The objective is the minimum normalized triangle area over all 165 triplets; in barycentric coordinates this is directly the absolute determinant. A seeded differential-evolution phase provides global exploration, followed by SLSQP refinement of the active area constraints. The result is cached on the function so repeated evaluation is effectively free, and a deterministic low-discrepancy fallback is returned if SciPy optimization is unavailable or fails.
